name: example
source:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 520 200"
     data-diagram-version="1">
  <title>Request and response</title>
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="10" refY="5"
            markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" orient="auto">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 Z" fill="#334155" />
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <line data-source="client" data-target="server"
        x1="190" y1="100" x2="330" y2="100"
        stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />

  <g id="client" data-node="true" transform="translate(30 60)">
    <title>Client</title>
    <desc>The client sends a request to the server.</desc>
    <rect width="160" height="80" rx="10"
          fill="#dbeafe" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="80" y="46" text-anchor="middle"
          font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172554">Client</text>
  </g>

  <g id="server" data-node="true" transform="translate(330 60)">
    <title>Server</title>
    <desc>The server processes the request and returns a response.</desc>
    <rect width="160" height="80" rx="10"
          fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="80" y="46" text-anchor="middle"
          font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#14532d">Server</text>
  </g>
</svg>

     width="900" height="480" role="img"
     aria-labelledby="title description">
  <title id="title">What is a Docker image?</title>
  <desc id="description">
    A Docker image is a read-only package of application files,
    libraries, runtime, and start settings. One image can start many
    containers. Each container has its own writable layer.
  </desc>

  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5"
            markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10Z" fill="#475569"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <rect width="900" height="480" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc"/>

  <g font-family="Arial, sans-serif" fill="#0f172a">
    <text x="40" y="48" font-size="28" font-weight="bold">
      What is a Docker image?
    </text>
    <text x="40" y="80" font-size="17" fill="#475569">
      A read-only package used to create containers.
    </text>

    <!-- Image: simplified example of file layers and settings -->
    <rect x="40" y="110" width="330" height="290" rx="16"
          fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="65" y="145" font-size="21" font-weight="bold">
      IMAGE
    </text>
    <text x="65" y="171" font-size="15" fill="#475569">
      Example: a Python application
    </text>

    <rect x="65" y="190" width="280" height="42" rx="7" fill="#bfdbfe"/>
    <text x="83" y="217" font-size="17">Application code</text>

    <rect x="65" y="240" width="280" height="42" rx="7" fill="#93c5fd"/>
    <text x="83" y="267" font-size="17">Required libraries</text>

    <rect x="65" y="290" width="280" height="42" rx="7" fill="#60a5fa"/>
    <text x="83" y="317" font-size="17">Python + base system files</text>

    <text x="65" y="365" font-size="16">
      Start command: python app.py
    </text>
    <text x="65" y="387" font-size="13" fill="#475569">
      Simplified file layers + start settings
    </text>

    <!-- One image can create multiple containers -->
    <g fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="2.5"
       marker-end="url(#arrow)">
      <path d="M370 245 H440 V193 H520"/>
      <path d="M440 245 V343 H520"/>
    </g>
    <text x="394" y="226" font-size="16">Run</text>

    <!-- Container A -->
    <rect x="535" y="120" width="325" height="130" rx="14"
          fill="white" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="558" cy="148" r="6" fill="#059669"/>
    <text x="574" y="154" font-size="19" font-weight="bold">
      CONTAINER A
    </text>
    <text x="555" y="181" font-size="16">Application is running</text>
    <rect x="550" y="196" width="295" height="36" rx="6" fill="#d1fae5"/>
    <text x="565" y="219" font-size="16">Own writable layer</text>

    <!-- Container B -->
    <rect x="535" y="270" width="325" height="130" rx="14"
          fill="white" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="558" cy="298" r="6" fill="#059669"/>
    <text x="574" y="304" font-size="19" font-weight="bold">
      CONTAINER B
    </text>
    <text x="555" y="331" font-size="16">Application is running</text>
    <rect x="550" y="346" width="295" height="36" rx="6" fill="#d1fae5"/>
    <text x="565" y="369" font-size="16">Own writable layer</text>

    <text x="450" y="440" text-anchor="middle"
          font-size="17" font-weight="bold">
      Containers share the image layers. The image stays unchanged.
    </text>
  </g>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 520 200"
     >
  <title>Request and response</title>
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="10" refY="5"
            markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" orient="auto">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 Z" fill="#334155" />
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <line data-source="client" data-target="server"
        x1="190" y1="100" x2="330" y2="100"
        stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />

  <g id="client" data-node="true" transform="translate(30 60)">
    <title>Client</title>
    <desc>The client sends a request to the server.</desc>
    <rect width="160" height="80" rx="10"
          fill="#dbeafe" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="80" y="46" text-anchor="middle"
          font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172554">Client</text>
  </g>

  <g id="server" data-node="true" transform="translate(330 60)">
    <title>Server</title>
    <desc>The server processes the request and returns a response.</desc>
    <rect width="160" height="80" rx="10"
          fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="80" y="46" text-anchor="middle"
          font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#14532d">Server</text>
  </g>
</svg>
